name: sistema-gestao-patrimonial
description: Sistema de Gestão Patrimonial para Prefeituras Municipais

scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:backend && npm run lint:fix:frontend

author: Sistema de Gestão Patrimonial
